title: Godot Crashes using `--benchmark-file` command line option and trying to close Godot
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.1.dev (`831b4a5366caf8a0202b2ac2fad641505282915c`) and later - Not Reproducible in: releases before `831b4a5366caf8a0202b2ac2fad641505282915c` commit, This commit added `--benchmark-file` option (changed `--startup-benchmark-file` to `--benchmark-file`), and improved benchmark system. ### System information Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads) - 14.94 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When running Godot with `--benchmark-file` option, trying to close Godot will crash the Engine. From my testing it didn't print the Backtrace (Godot halted for what seems indefinite time), had to compile from source with debug symbols to get relevant info. > [!NOTE] > Author of this issue is working on a fix for this, should be available in the next 24-48 hours. > About the custom builds below, it was compiled using the following command/build options. > `scons target=editor dev_mode=yes dev_build=yes debug_symbols=yes optimaze=none d3d12=no accesskit=no` > on a Windows 11 system using `cl.exe` (MSVC Compiler).

### Steps to reproduce 1. In a command prompt of your choice (`cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, etc...). Run the follow command: `path/to/godot.exe --benchmark-file "benchmark_results.txt"` replacing `path/to/godot.exe` with a real path pointing to Godot binary. 2. [**Optional**] Use Godot as you normally do, to gather more benchmark data. 3. Close Godot using `Alt+F4` or through the `X` button which closes Godot (found on the top right corner of the main running Godot window) 4. Notice that Godot crashes and tries to print a Backtrace of the callstack. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) None needed, steps provided under `Steps to reproduce` section should suffice.
